theorem lg_target {K : Type u_1} {g : GenContFract K} [DivisionRing K] : g.nums 0 = g.h := by
  rw [GenContFract.coe_toGenContFract]
  cases g with h s
  simp only [h, s, GenContFract.mk.inj.1, GenContFract.IntFractPair.mk.inj.1, GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream.eq_def]
  exact rfl
